page.overview:
Who is Behedesh II?

Behedesh II was a Tomb King and the King of Zandri. As the commander of the ground armies of Zandri, it was Behedesh II's duty to safeguard the Nehekharan capital city of Khemri from any army that might approach from the direction of his city-state. A master tactician in the conduct of desert warfare, Behedesh II and his Undead army lay in wait, coiled to strike like some monstrous creature of the sands.

Behedesh II met his end at the hands of the Vampire Lord Mannfred von Carstein's lieutenant Helmut von Carstein during the End Times at the battle of Ualatp's Temple when duelling wih Mannfred, granting him the final death.

Behedesh II may be the successor of King Behedesh of Zandri.
